source.quote_free_summary: A competitor's age for the whole Dance Season is the age on the last day of that Dance Season. Juniors are under 18, Adults 18 or older; Open and Masters divisions must be Adults, except that an Adult may dance with a partner aged 16 or above (Couples II.D.3.a-b); age-restricted divisions set minimum ages (for example Crystal 30, Diamond 40, Masters Plus 45, Silver 50, Crown 40, Crown Plus 55).

requirement: Competition OS does not calculate or verify this age rule. For initial activation the organizer verifies age-division eligibility and the decision is recorded (who, when, outcome, reason code). The UCWDC 16-or-older partner exception cannot be used through Competition OS while OD-02 prohibits every competitor under 18.

tests.name: a waiver never clears an age-restricted entry
refuses a waiver on an age-restricted division, a wrong reason, and a missing reason

enforcement_point: Organizer action and operational gate as for NDCA. No automated age calculation exists.
interpretation_notes: OD-03 Option C. UCWDC measures age at the last day of the Dance Season, which differs from NDCA (birthday plus 60-day window) and WSDC (close of the event); one global calculation would be wrong for at least two bodies. The 16+ partner exception in II.D.3.a-b is in direct tension with the OD-02 restriction: under OD-02 a 16 or 17 year old partner is refused, so affected UCWDC couples cannot register until Option A. Whose age counts in Pro-Am and Couples beyond these stipulations is NOT SPECIFIED IN PROVIDED SOURCE (AE-16) and stays unresolved.
